purpose: Regression-gate adjudications that preserve the immutable frozen truth while preventing known reference defects from being treated as product regressions.

overrides.reason: The additional locked reference entity comes from agentGemini/agent.py importing Agent from google.genai.adk. The pinned project declares google-genai rather than google-adk, while its own README documents the canonical Google ADK import as google.adk.agents.LlmAgent. Current official Google ADK Python 2.x uses google.adk / google.adk.agents. Do not add scanner support for this noncanonical namespace solely to satisfy the historical automated reference.
